messages:
sylvia: quick sanity check — onboarding run for llama3-compact hit two weirdnesses: 1) weights location ambiguity (we might have v1 vs v1.1 buckets), 2) tokenizer is inserting an extra end token inside chat templates which breaks prefix matching. can ops confirm exact canonical path and anyone who've seen chat-format deltas?

sylvia: model_config I'm using (snippet):
```yaml
model_name: llama3-compact
weights: gs://redwood-models/llama3-compact/v1/llama3-compact-quant.pt
tokenizer: hf/llama3-compact-tokenizer
tokenizer_options:
  add_bos: false
  add_eos: true
  special_tokens: {}
```

sylvia: observed behavior: prompt template "<s>[INST] user: ... [/INST]" becomes encoded with an extra <|endoftext|> between the system and user segments, so KV-cache alignment is off and early stopping triggers.

kevin: @sylvia will check buckets. I think we've got both v1 and v1.1 copies — v1.1 has a corrected merge. I can validate object metadata and perms in ~20m. :mag_right:

ops-bot: automated: gs://redwood-models/llama3-compact/ has objects: v1/ (size 12.3GB), v1.1/ (size 12.2GB). Access: project-redwood-inference-read.

dan: re: tokenizer: that extra token sounds like a special token mapping mismatch. some tokenizers use <s> vs <|startoftext|> and HF wrappers sometimes add eos in mid-template when add_eos=true and the template includes it literally. try setting add_eos: false for chat templates.

maria: small repro I ran locally:
```py
from transformers import AutoTokenizer
 t = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained('hf/llama3-compact-tokenizer')
 print(t.encode('<s>[INST] hello [/INST] user text'))
```
result includes 50256 token in middle (the eos token). swapping add_bos/add_eos flips position.

zeeshan: fwiw, integration test 483 failed in staging with similar prefix mismatch. I linked the run: https://ci.redwood.internal/runs/483 — looks like the prompt formatter inserts the system delimiter after we apply tokenizer's built-in special tokens.

sylvia: ok — plan: kevin to confirm canonical weights path (v1.1 preferred if checksum matches), dan to propose tokenizer_options change (add_eos:false + explicit special_tokens mapping) and a small test harness to verify token positions, maria to add a unit test, zeeshan to re-run integration once PR lands. I'll open PR with the config change + test.

kevin: confirmed: canonical path should be gs://redwood-models/llama3-compact/v1.1/llama3-compact-quant.pt. md5 matches release notes. I'll update the model registry entry after PR. :white_check_mark:

dan: proposed tokenizer_options:
```yaml
tokenizer_options:
  add_bos: true  # keep explicit BOS for chatfmt
  add_eos: false # avoid implicit EOS inside templates
  special_tokens:
    bos_token: '<s>'
    eos_token: '</s>'
    sep_token: '[INST]'
```
I'll attach a tiny script to assert token offsets for 5 canonical templates.

maria: PR review note: include the tiny encoding debug output as test assertions so flakiness is obvious. also add a comment mentioning why add_eos=false (link to this thread).

zeeshan: re-run plan after merge. if integration still fails, toggle to using the tokenizer's raw ids and run a mapping pass to strip problematic eos tokens before building KV caches.

sylvia: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/models/pull/1290 — includes config + unit test. tagging reviewers @dan @kevin @maria. please quick review — aiming to cut a canary tomorrow. :rocket:

kevin: will review in next 2h. if all green we can cut canary this afternoon.

triage-bot: reminder: add a rollback plan to the PR description for canary (template: canary rollback steps).

sylvia: thanks all — summary: use v1.1 weights, change tokenizer_options per Dan, unit tests added, PR open, kevin to update registry after merge, zeeshan to re-run staging. follow-ups in PR. :thumbsup:
